description: measure-guard: a Claude Code mod that shows the Measure plan state and guards edits, commits, and closeouts (from mods/measure-guard/DESIGN.md)
deviation_notes: Design changes from the brief, recorded in spec.md: (1) the active track is the first [~] track whose plan has a [~] task (the brief's 'first [~] track' denied all edits in this repository); (2) the task goes into conversation notes, not the system prompt (prompt cache); (3) /measure-on was added; (4) a SHA with or without backticks; (5) measure/-only commits pass with no [~] task. Task 1.4 replaced the live smoke test with a fixture sync script (no file access in tests). hooks/load.ts was folded into register.tsx (the $ import rule). All 9 manual verification tasks are deferred to the user ([b] deferred:user); the track stays [~] until the user verifies.

sprint.goal: Claude Code follows the Measure Task Workflow, because a mod shows the plan state and stops work that the active plan does not cover.
sprint.demo_notes: 85 tests across 10 files pass; claude plugin validate --strict passes. Live load: claude -p --plugin-dir ./mods/measure-guard in this repository, the model received the task note for Task 9.4 of this track and the fixed rule section. Manual verification of each phase is pending (deferred:user).
